detailed_descriptions.en: Before the Cataclysm shattered the continents, the Magi walked Elemental as its greatest channelers. Ereog, first of their order, cast down Az-Adoras and raised Hallas from a settlement to a great city. The Magi founded the Order of Anthuane, built monuments that outlasted kingdoms, and forged artifacts so powerful that their makers were undone by them. Then the world broke. Oceans swallowed mountains. Cities toppled. Most of what the Magi knew was lost. Most. Not all. Treasures of the Magi sends you into the ruins they left behind. Lost Treasures of a Vanished Age Dozens of new lairs are scattered across Elemental: vaults, tombs, and hidden caches sealed before the Cataclysm and left undisturbed in the century since. Elemental weapons that still carry the mark of the Magi who enchanted them, including a new line of magic wands for the mage class. A poison proof set of legendary armor, forged for an order that knew what walked the old world. The deeper you dig, the more of the old age you pull back into the light. Potions of Transformation A new line of consumable potions sits in the deepest vaults of the Magi. Each one transforms your champions into bears, ogres, golems, or dragons for the duration of a single battle, giving you the option to fight as something other than yourself when the situation calls for it. New Quests, New Stories A new chain of quests reaches back into the age of the Magi: stories that never appeared in War of Magic, Fallen Enchantress, or Sorcerer King. Follow the trail of an order that reshaped the world and decide what is made of what they left behind. The Guardians Still Stand The Magi did not leave their works unprotected. Golem variants: gold, silver, granite, and marble - still hold watch over the ruins they were set to guard, each with different resistances and methods of ending intruders. New monsters have moved into the wilds between. The world has grown considerably more dangerous for the curious. A World Worth Returning To In Elemental, every age is built on the bones of the one before it. Treasures of the Magi is designed to make your next campaign through Elemental: Reforged feel like a different world - one with more history buried in it, and more reasons to go looking. What the Magi lost is yours to find.

Before the Cataclysm shattered the continents, the Magi walked Elemental as its greatest channelers. Ereog, first of their order, cast down Az-Adoras and raised Hallas from a settlement to a great city. The Magi founded the Order of Anthuane, built monuments that outlasted kingdoms, and forged artifacts so powerful that their makers were undone by them.

Then the world broke. Oceans swallowed mountains. Cities toppled. Most of what the Magi knew was lost.

Most. Not all.

Treasures of the Magi sends you into the ruins they left behind.

Lost Treasures of a Vanished Age

Dozens of new lairs are scattered across Elemental: vaults, tombs, and hidden caches sealed before the Cataclysm and left undisturbed in the century since. Elemental weapons that still carry the mark of the Magi who enchanted them, including a new line of magic wands for the mage class. A poison proof set of legendary armor, forged for an order that knew what walked the old world. The deeper you dig, the more of the old age you pull back into the light.

Potions of Transformation

A new line of consumable potions sits in the deepest vaults of the Magi. Each one transforms your champions into bears, ogres, golems, or dragons for the duration of a single battle, giving you the option to fight as something other than yourself when the situation calls for it. 

New Quests, New Stories

A new chain of quests reaches back into the age of the Magi: stories that never appeared in War of Magic, Fallen Enchantress, or Sorcerer King. Follow the trail of an order that reshaped the world and decide what is made of what they left behind.

The Guardians Still Stand

The Magi did not leave their works unprotected. Golem variants: gold, silver, granite, and marble - still hold watch over the ruins they were set to guard, each with different resistances and methods of ending intruders. New monsters have moved into the wilds between. The world has grown considerably more dangerous for the curious.

In Elemental, every age is built on the bones of the one before it. Treasures of the Magi is designed to make your next campaign through Elemental: Reforged feel like a different world - one with more history buried in it, and more reasons to go looking.

What the Magi lost is yours to find.
